figurative_meaning_bn: যে নারী বীরত্ব অঙ্গে ধারণ করে; বীর্যবতী নারী
figurative_meaning_en: A woman who embodies bravery; a courageous woman
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন সত্যিকারের বীরাঙ্গনা, যিনি কখনো ভয় পান না।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a true virangana, who never fears anything.
The viranganas of the Liberation War are the pride of our country.
history: The term 'বীরাঙ্গনা' (Birangona) was coined by Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in 1972 to honor and rehabilitate women who were victims of sexual violence during the 1971 Bangladesh Liberation War against Pakistan.
note: This term carries deep emotional and nationalistic connotations in Bangladeshi culture, often used to denote resilience and honor.
